en_title: Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected
subtitle: 标志性的露齿笑
opus_summary: 万代南梦宫公布《铁拳8》范马勇次郎预告，造型如粉丝预期般诡异。小罗杰将于11月推出，勇次郎尚未定档，新预告将于2027年1月17日随巡回赛总决赛亮相。

paragraphs.en: Bandai Namco has revealed a first look at Tekken 8 DLC character Yujiro Hanma, and the Baki rep is looking just as uncanny as fans expected.
paragraphs.cn: 万代南梦宫首次展示了《铁拳8》DLC角色范马勇次郎。这位来自《刃牙》的角色，造型果然如粉丝预期般诡异。

paragraphs.en: The new trailer for the fighting game's Season 3 characters debuted alongside Evo France 2026. Following Kunimitsu's release in June and Bob's release in August, kangaroo-and-joey fighter Roger Jr. is now officially set for a November 11 early access launch, with the full release following November 16, but the character most fans are looking forward to is still without a proper release date.
paragraphs.cn: 这款格斗游戏的第3赛季角色新预告在Evo France 2026期间亮相。继州光于6月、鲍勃于8月推出后，由袋鼠母子搭档出战的小罗杰现已正式确定于11月11日开放抢先体验，11月16日正式上线。不过，多数粉丝最期待的那位角色仍未公布确切上线日期。

paragraphs.en: Roger Jr. is definitely the star of the new Tekken 8 DLC trailer, with nearly three minutes of its four-minute runtime dedicated to showing off the marsupial boxer's gameplay. The Yujiro teaser, meanwhile, is tucked at the end, but its reveals are particularly shocking. You can see how the Baki the Grappler villain has been reimagined within the world of Tekken below.
paragraphs.cn: 小罗杰无疑是这段《铁拳8》DLC新预告的主角：预告全长4分钟，其中近3分钟都在展示这位袋鼠拳手的实机玩法。勇次郎的片段则放在末尾，但展示的内容格外令人震惊。下方视频展示了这位《刃牙》反派来到《铁拳》世界后的全新形象。

paragraphs.en: Yujiro is… expressive, to say the least, so nailing his face and bulging muscles was always going to draw attention. Well, the Bandai Namco team did their best, with today's Evo trailer showing just a few shots of his iconic toothy smile and flexibility.
paragraphs.cn: 勇次郎的表情……至少可以说是相当丰富，因此，如何还原他的面容和隆起的肌肉，注定会引人关注。嗯，万代南梦宫团队已经尽力了。今天的Evo预告只用了几个镜头，展示他标志性的露齿笑容和身体柔韧性。

paragraphs.en: It looks like work on the anime guest character is still underway, but just because there's no release date doesn't mean there isn't a plan to show more. The end of the new teaser promised that a new Yujiro trailer will premiere alongside the Tekken World Tour Finals January 17, 2027. That's three months out from now, so we can probably expect to see gameplay by that point.
paragraphs.cn: 这位动画联动角色似乎仍在开发中，不过，尚未公布上线日期，并不代表团队没有计划展示更多内容。新预告结尾明确表示，勇次郎的新预告将于2027年1月17日，在铁拳世界巡回赛总决赛期间首播。距离现在还有3个月，因此到时我们或许能看到实机玩法。

paragraphs.en: Looking back at the calendar, Bandai Namco has typically had a few months of downtime between Tekken 8 DLC releases. It will have been two months since Roger Jr. was released when the Yujiro trailer is shared, meaning we can also expect a release date announcement around that time, too. If we're lucky, the Baki fighter might even drop that same day, but again, nothing regarding his release date has been confirmed quite yet.
paragraphs.cn: 回顾此前的日程，万代南梦宫通常会在《铁拳8》两次DLC上线之间留出几个月的间隔。等勇次郎新预告公布时，小罗杰上线也已过去两个月，因此我们也可以期待团队在那段时间公布勇次郎的上线日期。如果运气好，这位《刃牙》角色甚至可能当天就上线。不过，还是要强调，目前他的上线日期尚无任何确切消息。

paragraphs.en: Roger Jr. and Yujiro are both included in the Season 3 pass and will round out its promise of four bonus characters. Season 1 and Season 2 included fighters like Heihachi, Armor King, Anna, and Final Fantasy 16 protagonist Clive Rosfield. While passes cost $30 each, the Season 3 pass is currently available for $34.99.
paragraphs.cn: 小罗杰和勇次郎均包含在第3赛季通行证中，两人推出后，该通行证承诺的4名追加角色便将全部到齐。第1和第2赛季的角色包括平八、装甲豹王、安娜，以及《最终幻想16》主角克莱夫·罗兹菲尔德等。此前的赛季通行证每份售价30美元(约合人民币201元)，第3赛季通行证目前售价则为34.99美元(约合人民币234元)。

paragraphs.en: IGN learned more about Yujiro's inclusion in Tekken 8 when speaking with producer Naoya Yasuda and director of promotions and former Baki manga editor Yuki Yokoi earlier this year. Be sure to read the full interview for insight into how and why the team decided to include a character that never loses. You can also read about how former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada influenced one of Roger Jr.'s best references , and the player who climbed through the ranks while blindfolded .
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，IGN采访了制作人Naoya Yasuda，以及宣传总监、前《刃牙》漫画编辑Yuki Yokoi，了解了更多关于勇次郎加入《铁拳8》的细节。
